pcs.pc_description: visually inspect the body components for cracks and bearing wear
check if tyre inflation pressure corresponds to that prescribed norms of the manufacturer
ensure that wheel nuts are firmly tightened as per prescribed norms of the manufacturer
check oil levels of engine transmission, radiator coolant and brake
check hydraulic oil levels as per the prescribed norms of the manufacturer
check water system for leaks and clean water pump filter per the prescribed norms of the manufacturer
drain water and sediment from the fuel tank as per operational manual
ensure that the mixer drums are clean and free from concrete
ensure not to fill the fuel tank while engine is running
check battery electrolyte level as per the prescribed norms of the manufacturer
check electronic weighing system for any malfunctioning
apply grease to all grease nipples as per the prescribed norms of the manufacturer
ensure that the area is clear of all personnel and equipment before moving the equipment
ensure driver's seat, steps and handles are always clean and free from any foreign object or grease trials, oil mud and unfastened objects in the cabin
ensure proper condition of parking brake, main horn, reverse horn and head light
check all protection and safety for appropriate position for operation
maintain a checking/maintenance logbook to record all activities performed before starting the machine
report defects precisely to the supervisor if beyond scope of the role

pcs.pc_description: plan and organize the job according to instructions from the supervisor
inspect the worksite to identify and loose soil hidden deep trenches or marshy patches where a mixer could get stuck
fill water tanks ready for daily use as per organizational standards
carry out all peruse and running checks as per organizational standards
wear seat belt and adjust seat position to one's comfort
start the engine using the starting key
ensure parking brake is engaged and electric gear selector is in neutral position before starting the engine
select appropriate type of steering mechanism as per the situational requirements
load correct proportions of aggregates, cement, water and admixtures as per the production requirements
ensure mixer load and operating speed is within specified limits as per the manufacturer's
adjust the direction of drum rotation for mixing as per the requirement
adjust the concrete chute to the discharge position
discharge concrete to the desired location at the site
use the emergency stop button to disable all power to the transit mixer in case of a crisis as per operational manual
turn off ignition after finishing operations as per the instructions given in the instructional manual
ensure gear is in neutral position post usage
ensure bucket drum and concrete-skid are cleaned as per the manufacturer's instructional manual
remove attachments after use
ensure that the machine is secured when left unattended
maintain a production logbook to record all activities performed
report defects precisely to the supervisor if beyond scope of the role
